newsitem.title: BELGIUM: HORTA'S HALLET HOUSE FOR SALE.
newsitem.headline: HORTA'S HALLET HOUSE FOR SALE.

text.p: One of the few remaining houses designed and built by Belgian art nouveau architect Victor Horta has been put up for sale, price tag a minimum 50 million francs ($1.4 million).

The house on Brussels' exclusive Avenue Louise was built by the architect in 1903 for lawyer friend Max Hallet, after who it is named. It is being sold by brother and sister Willy and Annie De Proost, whose father bought the property in 1945.
The house has so far been used only for residential purposes, although could in the future be converted to offices, Dechamps & Levie Associates, the notaries handling the sale said.
The sale is due to take place on May 20. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
